title: Senior Software Engineer, Atlas API Experience - Integrations
text:
Senior Software Engineer, Atlas API Experience - Integrations

The Atlas API Experience (APIx) teams are part of MongoDB Atlas Data Services, a diverse group of individuals who develop the capabilities to run MongoDB globally (see MongoDB Atlas ). Our software and services allow users to deploy fault-tolerant, scalable, globally distributed MongoDB clusters in minutes. APIx’s mission is to craft delightful experiences for developers of all levels onboarding and working with MongoDB.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing team, building tooling to automate infrastructure on any cloud and developing MongoDB integrations that seamlessly integrate into partner frameworks or solutions. As part of the team, you will propose, design, build and support product features supporting integrations such as AWS Cloud Formation & AWS CDK, Terraform & Vault. You will build our next generation Atlas SDK for an expanding set of languages. Automation & DevOps is at our core, with the number of Integrations & SDKs continuing to grow. You will be part of building a platform that allows our team to scale with that growth.

We are looking for passionate, intrinsically-motivated software engineers who consistently work to grow their skills and want to take their careers to the next level. No prior experience with MongoDB technologies is required! During interviews, you will meet most of our team and have the opportunity to ask questions about working at MongoDB. We pride ourselves on our team's culture and on being an inclusive and collaborative group that Builds Together .

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What will you do?

- Propose, design, implement and support product features for MongoDB Atlas DevOps & SDK tooling, such as MongoDB Atlas Cloud Formation Resources , MongoDB Atlas Terraform Provider & MongoDB Atlas Go SDK
- Build tooling that enables MongoDB users and developers to succeed, using programming languages such as Golang (primary), Java, Python & Javascript/Typescript (Experience in at least one of the above is desirable)
- Design and develop software integration components utilizing MongoDB’s technology (i.e. database, mobile, search, etc.) in larger contexts and integrate into partner frameworks or solutions
- Incrementally ship elements of sophisticated projects
- Assist with investigating and solving problems experienced by our customers, Our team has a Level 2 support rotation
- Apply our core values to your planning, designing, and coding work

Who are you?

We understand not everyone will meet all the qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply

- Inspired by building DevOps & automated tooling that manages deployments at scale
- Approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
- Collaborate and communicate effectively across multiple teams, locally & remote across timezones, internally and externally as required, to drive projects to completion
- Enjoys an environment where you can coordinate your own time, prioritizing, and acting on multiple tasks concurrently without manager oversight
- Some experience building Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tooling & integrations
- Familiar with cloud infrastructure platforms, tools and concepts ( Amazon AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, etc )

How will you measure success?

- In three months, you'll have become familiar with our developer tools and the existing features most relevant to integrations
- In six months, you will be building features and leading your projects. You will share knowledge with the team, collaborating where needed to achieve our team goals
- In nine months, you will be fully embedded in the team. As well as leading your projects, you will be contributing ideas to the team roadmap, improving how we work. You will be mentoring other team members, helping them learn from your experience

What is in it for you?

- Generous compensation package (top-range salary, equity, comprehensive benefits)
- Flexible working options with a focus on results rather than time spent in the office
- A high level of independence in your day-to-day work. Propose innovative solutions to existing problems and own the delivery from start to finish
- Opportunities to learn on the job (time and support to upskill in new technologies and learn new programming languages, as well as an allowance for educational material)
- Exposure to a wide variety of market verticals and a broad spectrum of interesting use cases
- You'll be joining a supportive and collaborative team that values its culture and promotes a positive work environment!
- Upon joining, you will have the opportunity to learn everything there is to know about MongoDB via specialized training on the MongoDB University platform and highly supportive colleagues

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

text:
Staff Frontend Engineer

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

Staff Frontend Engineer

An overview of this role

As a Staff Frontend Engineer on the Core DevOps team, you'll provide technical leadership across your team and adjacent teams. You'll solve complex frontend problems, deliver large features with minimal guidance, and improve the architecture and standards that help teams move faster without compromising quality.

You'll work with product, design, engineering managers, and engineers across product groups to shape product experiences and frontend architecture for a global platform. This includes how teams use agentic artificial intelligence in engineering workflows and user experiences.

At GitLab, we build an all-remote, artificial intelligence-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll help shape product experiences and frontend architecture that enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

What you’ll do

- Lead the technical design and delivery of large, complex frontend initiatives across multiple teams.
- Drive frontend platform, design system, and shared architecture strategy for long-term scalability.
- Define and improve standards for versioning, testing, documentation, accessibility, security, performance, and maintainability.
- Lead modernization of a monolith or legacy frontend architecture toward modular, reusable, and independently deployable systems.
- Establish versioned module or host contracts and build, test, deploy, release, and rollback practices for safe operations.
- Create shared patterns for dependency management, design system integration, observability, error isolation, and performance budgets.
- Guide technical direction through clear written proposals and architectural leadership. Partner with product and engineering leaders on platform roadmaps, technical debt, and investment trade-offs.
- Mentor senior and intermediate engineers. Establish guardrails for artificial-intelligence-assisted and agentic workflows that protect code quality, security, privacy, and evaluation standards.

What you’ll bring

- A sustained record of technical leadership across teams or a broad product area.
- Deep frontend architecture and production experience in complex web applications.
- Experience scaling or governing a design system, frontend platform, or shared component architecture.
- Experience with modular frontend architecture in production, such as package encapsulation, Web Components, frontend islands, runtime composition, or an equivalent architecture.
- Experience creating alignment without formal authority through clear written proposals and decision records.
- Experience balancing user outcomes, delivery speed, technical health, and long-term platform investment.
- Experience mentoring engineers and shaping standards through code review and documentation, including evaluating and improving artificial-intelligence-assisted or agentic engineering workflows.
- Helpful, but not required: experience with Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript, or JavaScript; PostgreSQL, Redis, or object storage; representational state transfer or GraphQL application programming interfaces; Kubernetes, Google Kubernetes Engine, Docker, or Google Cloud Platform; and observability tools such as Prometheus or Sentry.

About the team

On the Core DevOps team, we own core repository capabilities, from Git command-line operations to web-based code exploration. We develop new features and platforms, improve existing capabilities, and improve maintainability, accessibility, performance, and workflows for teams using artificial-intelligence-assisted development tools.

- Flexible Paid Time Off
- Team Member Resource Groups
- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Growth and Development Fund

Binance Accelerator Programm - Software Engineer (Full-stack / AI-oriented)

Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE .

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.

*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws

Responsibilities
- Participate in the full-stack development and maintenance of the KYC (Know Your Customer) system, covering both backend services and frontend features
- Assist in drafting and implementing the interface documentation for KYC business modules
- Participate in feature testing and regression for KYC releases, and help troubleshoot issues reported by the QA team
- Support the CS team in resolving and classifying customer issues for system improvement

Requirements

- Full-stack interest: some frontend foundation (HTML/CSS/JavaScript); familiarity with React or Vue is preferred
- Good logical thinking, teamwork and a strong willingness to learn
- Able to read and write technical documents in English; good spoken English is an advantage

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

text:
Software Engineer 3, Data Pipeline

The Data Pipeline team, within the MongoDB Observability organization, builds and supports scalable, highly available capabilities for transporting and transforming telemetry data across MongoDB. The team's mission is to provide a unified streaming pipeline that ingests data and processes high-throughput telemetry, enabling the migration of legacy observability solutions within MongoDB.

Built on a diskless, Kafka-compatible data streaming platform as the core streaming bus and Apache Flink for real-time transformations and delivery to storage, the platform lives on Kubernetes clusters and enables downstream consumers to access live telemetry for immediate analysis and reliable long-term retention. The main concern of this team is to provide reliable systems with high availability and replay capabilities.

About the role

We're looking for a Software Engineer 3 to help build and operate this platform. This is an individual contributor role that combines hands-on software development with systems and site reliability engineering. You'll contribute code and ship backend improvements, while also troubleshooting production issues and helping keep the services reliable.

If you enjoy both building distributed systems and understanding how they behave in production, this role offers the opportunity to work on high-volume telemetry processing with meaningful operational responsibility. You'll contribute to medium-sized technical projects and grow with support from experienced engineers.

We are looking to speak to candidates based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

We're looking for someone who

- Enjoys working with other engineers, is approachable and curious, and is open to feedback
- Has experience with Kafka-compatible streaming platforms, Apache Flink, or comparable stream-processing technologies
- Has experience writing production backend systems in a compiled language, such as Java, Go, C, or C++
- Has experience designing and developing scalable distributed services, with an understanding of performance, availability, and failure handling
- Has worked with event-driven systems, ingestion pipelines, or high-throughput data processing
- Has hands-on experience managing the development and release lifecycle on Kubernetes clusters using GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux
- Has hands-on experience applying a data-driven approach to debugging and troubleshooting production systems using tools such as profilers and flame graphs to collect evidence
- Is comfortable being part of 24/7 on-call rotations
- Can explain their own technical contributions, the trade-offs they made, and the evidence used to evaluate results
- Has a strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and time and space complexity

Nice to haves

- Experience with telemetry, metrics, logs, or observability infrastructure
- Experience using service-level indicators, objectives, or agreements to guide reliability improvements
- Experience improving monitoring, alerting, incident response, or operational automation

Role responsibilities

- Design, write, test and maintain backend code and features for the Data Pipeline platform
- Contribute to and lead medium-sized technical projects through production delivery
- Help improve the scalability, availability, and reliability of telemetry ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream storage
- Investigate production issues using metrics, logs, and other evidence, and contribute to fixes and preventative improvements
- Participate in the team's on-call rotation and support customer escalations with support engineers and teammates
- Be customer-driven by collaborating with the sister teams and customers to improve the Observability user experience
- Contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, coding best practices, and operational improvements

Success measures

- In 1 month, you'll be familiar with the systems the Data Pipeline team owns, the telemetry flow and the team's development practices, and you'll have completed minor codebase tasks
- In 3 months, you'll be contributing to the design and development of team projects and shipping changes regularly
- In 6 months, you'll be taking on small and medium-sized projects, contributing actively to technical discussions, proactively improving the platform, supporting customer escalations, and participating in the on-call rotation

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Site Reliability Engineer, Cells Infrastructure

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.

This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.

What you'll do

- Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.
- Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.
- Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.
- Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.
- Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.
- Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.
- Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.
- Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.

What you'll bring

- Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.
- Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.
- Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.
- Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
- Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.
- A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.
- Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.
- Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.

About the team

Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.

text:
Associate DevOps Engineer

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry , committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Nitro is an AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on. Our team is seeking an Associate DevOps Engineer to support our business consulting team’s AWS and Kubernetes analytics infrastructure as part of the broader NitroAI Team. You'll work alongside the team keeping this platform reliable and secure, with real ownership over the pieces you run day to day. This role needs solid technical fundamentals, but just as important is a customer-service mindset: you'll be supporting internal engineering teams directly, so how you communicate, troubleshoot with empathy, and show up when something's broken matters as much as the fix itself.

What You'll Do
- Support day-to-day operation of the AWS and Kubernetes platform - monitoring reliability and performance, flagging issues before they become incidents for 50 person global consulting team
- Build & Maintain GitOps deployments: sync policies, deployment ordering, configuration management
- Support CI/CD pipelines: maintain GitLab pipelines and runners, help engineering teams troubleshoot failed builds and deployments
- Act as first responder on platform incidents: triage, escalate, and help document post-mortems
- Maintain platform observability: monitoring, alerting, and log visibility
- Migrate 50 person business consulting team onto a new AI native stack
- Support the building of our new AI native application NitroAI to learn Veeva methodology

Requirements
- 1+ years hands-on experience with AWS and Kubernetes
- Working knowledge of GitLab CI/CD, including runner management and Bash scripting for deployment tasks
- Familiarity with GitOps practices (ArgoCD or similar)
- Exposure to Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code tool
- Strong communication skills and a customer-service mindset - you're supporting people, not just infrastructure
- Comfortable being accountable to other engineers who are blocked and waiting on you

Nice to Have
- EKS/Kubernetes RBAC and IRSA experience
- Broader AWS fluency: Lambda, ALB, WAF, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, Route53, KMS, ECR
- Apache Airflow experience via MWAA
- Proficiency with Claude Code
- Exposure to compliance/security-baseline work

Interviewing with Veeva
We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.
- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
- A conversation with the hiring manager
- A technical/coding skills exercise
- A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders
- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits
- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
- Retirement programs
- 1% charitable giving program

Compensation
- Base pay: $ 65,000 - $90,000
- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
